fairness_disclosures.swap_metric_note: Both compilers emit into basis {rz, sx, cx} so final_emitted_swaps == 0. QCC exposes router_swaps_inserted directly via CompilationManifest, whereas Qiskit transpile() decomposes routed SWAPs into 3 CX gates before returning the final circuit (`null`).
fairness_disclosures.timing_boundary_note: QCC wall-clock time measures black-box CLI subprocess execution (including process startup and file I/O) of one deterministic configuration; Qiskit time measures in-process Python PassManager.run() excluding circuit construction and oracle checks.
